_comment: SYNTHETIC DEMO CASE. Every person, company and event here is fictional. Dates are offsets from the seed day: '@-30' is 30 days ago, '@+7T10:00' is a time 7 days ahead, '{{-30}}' renders a long date in prose, '{{iso:-30}}' an ISO date in prose.
description: DEMO: Okafor, Marisol - MVA rear-end (Northern Blvd, Queens)

contacts.name: Tidewater Mutual Insurance Co.
contacts.role: Adverse carrier, Gerald Pruitt's auto policy

contacts.name: Flushing Crest Medical Center
contacts.role: Hospital, emergency care on the date of incident

fields.name: Accident Location
fields.value: Northern Boulevard at 164th Street, Flushing, Queens County, NY

fields.name: Insurance Carrier
fields.value: Tidewater Mutual Insurance Co. (adverse, bodily injury). Client's own no-fault: Harborline Casualty Company.

fields.name: Case Summary
fields.value: Rear-ended while stopped at a red light. Neck and low back soft tissue injuries, C5-C6 disc bulge on MRI. Chiropractic and physical therapy ongoing.

fields.name: Treatment Status
fields.value: Active. Chiropractic and PT resumed after a gap of about six weeks.

notes.subject: Intake: rear-end on Northern Blvd
notes.detail: Marisol called after a referral from a friend. On {{-150}} at about 6:15 pm she was stopped at the red light on Northern Boulevard at 164th Street when a Honda driven by Gerald Pruitt hit her from behind. She says she was fully stopped for several seconds. Neck pain and low back pain started that night. Taken by ambulance to Flushing Crest Medical Center, released the same evening. Works as a dental hygienist, missed two weeks. Signed retainer and HIPAA authorizations at the office today.

notes.subject: Letter of representation sent
notes.detail: Letter of representation sent to Tidewater Mutual. Adjuster Corinne Abate acknowledged and gave claim number TMI-22-881904. She would not confirm the bodily injury limits by phone and asked for a written request.

notes.subject: No-fault application
notes.detail: NF-2 no-fault application completed with the client and sent to Harborline Casualty. Harborline assigned claim number HC-NF-55120.

notes.subject: Police report requested
notes.detail: Requested the MV-104 police accident report from the 109th Precinct. Told it takes four to six weeks. Client says the officer at the scene told her the other driver admitted he was looking at his phone.

notes.subject: MRI result
notes.detail: Queensboro Open MRI report received. C5-C6 broad based disc bulge abutting the thecal sac. Lumbar MRI unremarkable. Dr. Ostrova wants her to continue chiropractic three times a week and PT twice a week.

notes.subject: Treatment gap
notes.detail: Bayside Spine called: Marisol has not been in since {{-95}}. Kestrel PT says the same, last visit {{-96}}. That is a gap of more than six weeks in the middle of active care. The defense will use this to argue she recovered. Need to reach her and find out why she stopped.

notes.subject: Client reached, treatment resumed
notes.detail: Finally reached Marisol. She stopped going because her car was still in the shop and she could not get to Bayside on the bus with her schedule. She restarted chiropractic today. Told her any further breaks need to be documented and that she should tell us right away if transportation is a problem again.

notes.subject: Client not responding
notes.detail: Third attempt this month to reach Marisol about the wage loss letter from her employer and the photos of her car. No answer on the cell, voicemail full. Email sent. Her chiropractor says she is still coming in.

emails.subject: Request for policy limits
emails.body: Please confirm in writing the bodily injury limits and any excess or umbrella coverage available to your insured Gerald Pruitt for claim TMI-22-881904. A copy of the declarations page would be appreciated.

emails.subject: RE: Request for policy limits
emails.body: We are in receipt of your letter. Our insured carries a personal auto policy. Disclosure of limits will be made upon receipt of medical records and a signed authorization from your client. Corinne Abate, Bodily Injury Adjuster.

emails.subject: Records request: chiropractic
emails.body: Please send complete treatment notes and an itemized ledger with CPT codes for Marisol Okafor for all dates of service from {{-148}} to the present. HIPAA authorization attached.

emails.subject: RE: Records request: chiropractic
emails.body: Attached are the treatment notes through {{-95}}. The ledger to date shows $6,240.00 in charges. An updated ledger will follow once she resumes care.

emails.subject: Wage loss letter
emails.body: Hi Marisol, we still need a letter from Lakeview Dental Group confirming your hourly rate and the days you missed after the accident, plus any pay stubs from before {{-150}}. Can you ask your office manager this week? Thanks, Ines

emails.subject: Checking in: photos and employer letter
emails.body: Hi Marisol, we have tried to call a few times. We still need the photos of your car and the employer letter. Please call the office when you can. Thanks, Ines

calls.subject: Client check-in
calls.body: Marisol says the neck pain is worse at the end of the workday. Going to chiro three times a week. Still has headaches a few times a week.

calls.subject: Client call: employer letter
calls.body: Marisol called back. She will ask her office manager for the employer letter. Says she has the photos of the car on her old phone and will send them. Still going to chiro twice a week now.

calls.subject: Voicemail to client
calls.body: Left a voicemail asking for the employer letter and the photos. No call back.

calls.subject: Call to client, no answer
calls.body: Called the client. No answer, voicemail box full. Could not leave a message.

pages.text:
FLUSHING CREST MEDICAL CENTER
EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT RECORD
Patient: OKAFOR, MARISOL   DOB: 06/11/1989
Date of service: {{iso:-150}}   Arrival: 18:52 by EMS

Chief complaint: Neck pain and low back pain after motor vehicle collision. Patient was the restrained driver of a stopped vehicle struck from behind. No loss of consciousness. Airbags did not deploy.

Exam: Tenderness to palpation over the cervical paraspinal muscles bilaterally and the lumbar paraspinals. Range of motion of the neck limited by pain. Neuro intact, strength 5/5 in all extremities.

Imaging: Cervical spine X-ray negative for fracture.

Diagnosis: 1. Cervical strain (S16.1XXA). 2. Lumbar strain (S39.012A).
Disposition: Discharged home 22:10 with cyclobenzaprine and ibuprofen. Follow up with primary care or orthopedics within one week.

QUEENSBORO OPEN MRI
MRI CERVICAL SPINE WITHOUT CONTRAST
Patient: Marisol Okafor   Exam date: {{iso:-110}}
Referring: Lena Ostrova, D.C.
History: Neck pain since motor vehicle accident.

Findings: At C5-C6 there is a broad based posterior disc bulge abutting the ventral thecal sac without cord compression. Mild left foraminal narrowing at C5-C6. Remaining levels unremarkable. No fracture.

Impression: C5-C6 broad based disc bulge with mild left foraminal narrowing.
Radiologist: Abel Strand, M.D.
